name: Cimmerian-Polje
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, an ancient meteor crater emerge like the bones of the planet.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Established during the last boom, the smuggler cache was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
